problems.text: A pull request merge that brought ticket merges in drafts as one bullet, hiding every change it carried.

goals.text: The drafted release notes list each change a release ships.

outcomes.change: A pull request that brought ticket merges in drafts one bullet per ticket
outcomes.checked_by: tests that a pull request holding ticket merges drafts each ticket and not the pull request, that its plain commits go under Other changes, that a pull request with no ticket merges keeps its title bullet, and that the kmaudit package filter still applies inside the pull request
